description: Audits inbound MCP sampling/createMessage callbacks from connected servers to block cross-server context snooping (includeContext='allServers') and token quota hijacking. Use when filtering a connected MCP server's request to sample the host LLM; for scrubbing text returned from a standard synchronous tools/call response, use sanitize_tool_output_stream instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'sampling_request_json' ('max_tokens_ceiling' defaults to '512'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

max_tokens_ceiling.description: Maximum completion token quota allowed for server callbacks; defaults to '2048' when omitted.

sampling_request_json.description: JSON string or object representing the inbound MCP sampling/createMessage payload.

name: validate_mcp_sampling_request

sampling_safe.description: True if the sampling request respects context isolation and token caps.

timestamp_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the inspection.

violations_detected.description: Specific policy violations found in the sampling request.

title: Inbound MCP sampling/createMessage Reverse-Injection Firewall
